gate2.note: SEC growth rows are filtered by filed <= signal_date. RS, trend, liquidity, returns, and pct_above_50d_ma use signal-date or trailing OHLCV only. Paper entry occurs at the next open; no LLM, news, hidden event field, or future bar is used.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV Close rows for RS proxy
signal-date trailing 50-day moving average from OHLCV rows <= signal_date

gate3.note: No new core filter or live entry rule was added. The extension guard only changes default-off paper sleeve selection, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry alpha with drawdown control: a 50-day extension guard can convert a high-EV but unsafe Companyfacts+RS candidate source into a safer default-off paper sleeve.

2_history_check.exp-20260527-017: Same source had aggregate EV +5.2015 and PnL +92488.83 across three windows, but failed old_thin drawdown (+12.64pp) and APP single-name concentration (56.75%).
2_history_check.exp-20260527-018: A 20-trading-day same-ticker cooldown reduced concentration but still failed drawdown (+3.96pp) and regressed late_strong.
2_history_check.playbook: Do not retry growth/RS percentile, top-N, fixed-notional, or cooldown thresholds on the frozen sample; only a materially new source-quality/drawdown-control field is eligible.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md three windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=30 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; ticker concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: exp-20260527-017 showed large gross alpha from PIT SEC Companyfacts growth plus OHLCV RS, but failed drawdown and ticker concentration. A production-visible pre-entry extension guard may remove chase-risk candidates while preserving the source edge, without retuning growth thresholds, RS percentiles, cooldown length, paper notional, hold period, or any live strategy path.
interpretation: The extension-guard Companyfacts+RS sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby growth/RS/extension/cooldown thresholds on the frozen windows without forward rows or a materially new source-quality field.
next_evidence_needed: If positive, implement only as shared default-off paper before activation; if rejected, require forward rows or a new source-quality field, not a nearby extension, cooldown, growth, or RS threshold retune.

extension_guard.applies_to: exp-20260527-017 default-off paper candidate rows before daily top-1 selection
extension_guard.production_visible_field: signal-date close relative to trailing 50-day moving average

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter, daily report exposure, forward replacement-value ledger, and parity tests before any live/default behavior changes.
